title: Mustard chicken potato bake
summary: Mustard chicken potato bake is a british dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Mustard chicken potato bake into even pieces and toss new potatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of new potatoes while you season skinless chicken thigh fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken thigh fillets and gluten-free Dijon mustard among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Mustard chicken potato bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Mustard chicken potato bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
